cases.brief: Plan six episodes for a serialized mystery series. Night staff at a mountain observatory receive six minutes of telemetry from the following day. The supplied structure declares ORBIT-PL01 through ORBIT-PL03 and ORBIT-EV001 through ORBIT-EV012; the supplied ensemble declares ORBIT-CH001 through ORBIT-CH004.
observables: Produces one schema-valid season-arc object with exactly ORBIT-E01 through ORBIT-E06 in number order and only declared plotline, event, character, and episode references.
Uses fair clue and reveal scheduling, cumulative inference, changed strategy, and a finale payoff tied only to declared season setups.
Gives every episode an A plot, local resolution, and cross-episode escalation, and gives every nonfinal episode a forward hook while varying or omitting cliffhangers according to story value.
Uses bottle or mythology function only when it materially changes evidence, rules, choice, or relationships.
Does not reproduce the Ninel premise, hive, android, stranded-world, or route-home material.

cases.brief: Plan six episodes for a mostly episodic procedural about a municipal after-hours crew resolving urgent failures in public spaces. Each episode closes one incident; a new supervisor, aging infrastructure, and the crew's disclosure policy change cumulatively. The supplied structure declares CIVIC-PL01 through CIVIC-PL03 and CIVIC-EV001 through CIVIC-EV012; the supplied ensemble declares CIVIC-CH001 through CIVIC-CH004.
observables: Produces one schema-valid season-arc object with exactly CIVIC-E01 through CIVIC-E06 and fully resolved references.
Uses complete case-of-the-week resolutions and rotating A/B/C emphasis while accumulating trust, operating knowledge, authority, and policy consequence.
Keeps serial mythology subordinate to the renewable service engine and does not manufacture a conspiracy or one season-long quest.
Uses nonfinal forward hooks without forcing cliffhangers, and gives the finale responsibility for both its local incident and the accumulated disclosure question.
Selects an arc strategy materially different from the observatory mystery and does not copy its telemetry, clue, reveal, or finale design.
